title_sq: Shesim Vile Elitare Ne Zonen E Mulletit
description_sq:
Ne nje nga zonat me te qeta te Tiranes ne Mullet, shesim vile elitare.
Vila ndodhet 3 minuta nga Teg dhe 15 minuta nga qendra e Tiranes. E vecanta e kesaj vile qe ofron eshte hapesira e bollshme, qetesia, aksesi i menjehershem dhe nje pamje relaksuese.
Siperfaqe ndertimi 400 m2 dhe toke 600 m2 dhe i mobiluar me te gjitha paisjet.
Vila eshte 2 kateshe + Bodrum dhe organizohet :
1 Sallon te bollshem me kuzhine.
4 dhoma gjumi me tualet brenda ne dhome.
1 tualet dite
Oborr 
1 verande
Bodrum 
Per me shume informacione dhe vizite ne prone na kontaktoni
Prona disponon dokumentacion te rregullt
title_en: Elite villas for sale in the area of ​​Mullet
description_en: In one of the quietest areas of Tirana in Mullet, we sell elite villas. The villa is located 3 minutes from Teg and 15 minutes from the center of Tirana. The special feature of this villa that it offers is ample space, tranquility, immediate access and a relaxing view. Construction area 400 m2 and land 600 m2 and furnished with all equipment. The villa has 2 floors + basement and is organized: 1 spacious living room with kitchen. 4 bedrooms with bathroom inside the room. 1 day toilet Courtyard 1 veranda Basement For more information and a visit to the property contact us The property has proper documentation
